message.text: I need to find every RPC method in ShortcutService and identify the backend file that implements each one.
All five RPCs are implemented in `shortcut_service.go` on `APIV1Service`.

All five RPCs are implemented in `shortcut_service.go`.

Connect wrappers delegate to underlying implementations rather than handling business logic directly.

q14.

**RPCs:** ListShortcuts, GetShortcut, CreateShortcut, UpdateShortcut, DeleteShortcut

**Implementing file:** `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`

All five are declared on `ShortcutService` in `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` and implemented as `APIV1Service` methods in that file:

| RPC | Handler |
|---|---|
| ListShortcuts | `APIV1Service.ListShortcuts` (line 49) |
| GetShortcut | `APIV1Service.GetShortcut` (line 95) |
| CreateShortcut | `APIV1Service.CreateShortcut` (line 135) |
| UpdateShortcut | `APIV1Service.UpdateShortcut` (line 211) |
| DeleteShortcut | `APIV1Service.DeleteShortcut` (line 284) |

Connect wrappers in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` delegate to these methods and do not contain the business logic.
